This [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] '''insectoid species''' was native to<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> [[Thrakia]],<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> which was located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for [[Thrakia system/Legends|Thrakia system]]</ref> These [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] were capable of genetically transmitting memories,<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> and, some [[300 BBY/Legends|three hundred years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="CET" /> they remembered that, in the recent past, they had communicated only through scent before apparently discovering that they could also communicate by clicking their mandibles.<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> Even after many years,<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /> during the [[8 ABY/Legends|early days]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="CPL" /> they continued to regard this ability with awe and viewed it as a sign that they had been gifted by a power<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CET" /> from some higher being.<ref name="CPL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thrakia and its inhabitants were first mentioned in the novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'',<ref name="CPL" /> which was written by [[Dave Wolverton]] and released in [[1994]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
